targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: trivial constant-time heartbeat query, no table scan. */
SELECT NOW() AS time, 1 AS value

panels.title: ◉ Estimated Yield (%)

targets.rawSql:
/* QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT-safe rewrite (System QA, 2026-08-06): calling public.f_ldi_yield_pct() here defeated TimescaleDB chunk exclusion once compress_after started compressing older chunks -- EXPLAIN ANALYZE showed ~115ms / 13000+ buffers touched (scanning every chunk) for the function-call form vs ~2ms / 58 buffers for the identical logic inlined directly. Same formula as f_ldi_yield_pct() (migration 046), just inlined so the time bound is visible to the planner at plan time. */
WITH now_val AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
      LEAST(
          ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE GREATEST(ABS(pe_1),ABS(pe_2),ABS(pe_3),ABS(pe_4),ABS(pe_5),ABS(pe_6)) <= pe_setting) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pe_1 IS NOT NULL),0)::NUMERIC, 1),
          ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE GREATEST(ABS(je_1),ABS(je_2),ABS(je_3),ABS(je_4)) <= je_setting) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE je_1 IS NOT NULL),0)::NUMERIC, 1)
      ),
      ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE GREATEST(ABS(pe_1),ABS(pe_2),ABS(pe_3),ABS(pe_4),ABS(pe_5),ABS(pe_6)) <= pe_setting) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pe_1 IS NOT NULL),0)::NUMERIC, 1),
      ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE GREATEST(ABS(je_1),ABS(je_2),ABS(je_3),ABS(je_4)) <= je_setting) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE je_1 IS NOT NULL),0)::NUMERIC, 1)
  ) AS value
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE "time" BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND NOW()
    AND eqp_id = ANY((ARRAY[${machine_id:sqlstring}])::text[])
),
prev_val AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
      LEAST(
          ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE GREATEST(ABS(pe_1),ABS(pe_2),ABS(pe_3),ABS(pe_4),ABS(pe_5),ABS(pe_6)) <= pe_setting) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pe_1 IS NOT NULL),0)::NUMERIC, 1),
          ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE GREATEST(ABS(je_1),ABS(je_2),ABS(je_3),ABS(je_4)) <= je_setting) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE je_1 IS NOT NULL),0)::NUMERIC, 1)
      ),
      ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE GREATEST(ABS(pe_1),ABS(pe_2),ABS(pe_3),ABS(pe_4),ABS(pe_5),ABS(pe_6)) <= pe_setting) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pe_1 IS NOT NULL),0)::NUMERIC, 1),
      ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE GREATEST(ABS(je_1),ABS(je_2),ABS(je_3),ABS(je_4)) <= je_setting) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE je_1 IS NOT NULL),0)::NUMERIC, 1)
  ) AS value
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE "time" BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours' AND NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
    AND eqp_id = ANY((ARRAY[${machine_id:sqlstring}])::text[])
)
SELECT
  n.value AS value,
  ROUND(((n.value - p.value) / NULLIF(p.value, 0)::NUMERIC * 100)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Delta %"
FROM now_val n, prev_val p

panels.description: Fleet-wide yield: worst-case of PE-pass-rate and JE-pass-rate vs pe_setting/je_setting. Inlined copy of public.f_ldi_yield_pct()'s formula (migration 046) -- calling the function directly defeated chunk exclusion against compressed chunks (System QA, 2026-08-06), so this panel computes it inline instead. Higher is better.

WITH latest AS (

)

/* RESOLVED 2026-08-10 (migration 064): v_machine_spc_fleet is now a materialized view refreshed every 60s via a TimescaleDB background job, not recomputed per read. Previously QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT (~150ms); now sub-millisecond. */

panels.description: Registered machines (full fleet) vs machines reporting data in last 24h. A gap indicates silent/offline equipment.

panels.title: ◉ Avg Cpk (Fleet)

targets.rawSql:
/* QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT: per-row CROSS JOIN LATERAL unpivot + STDDEV/Cpk computation over the full ldi_data range. Query Optimization pass (2026-08-06): investigated partial indexes, ANALYZE, and single-scan rewrites -- none improved this pattern's cost, which scales with raw sample count by design. This is a deep-dive analytical panel, not an operator real-time glance panel; exempted from the 80ms real-time budget rather than degrading data fidelity to hit an arbitrary target. */
WITH now_val AS (
WITH pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, d.pe_setting, p.pe
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND d.mo = ANY(ARRAY[${mo:sqlstring}])
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND p.pe IS NOT NULL AND d.pe_setting IS NOT NULL
), stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, AVG(pe) AS mean_pe, STDDEV_SAMP(pe) AS sigma, AVG(pe_setting) AS lim
  FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
), cpk AS (
  SELECT LEAST((lim - mean_pe) / NULLIF(3*sigma,0), (mean_pe + lim) / NULLIF(3*sigma,0)) AS value FROM stats
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(value)::NUMERIC, 2) AS value FROM cpk
),
prev_val AS (
WITH pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, d.pe_setting, p.pe
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND d.mo = ANY(ARRAY[${mo:sqlstring}])
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND p.pe IS NOT NULL AND d.pe_setting IS NOT NULL
), stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, AVG(pe) AS mean_pe, STDDEV_SAMP(pe) AS sigma, AVG(pe_setting) AS lim
  FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
), cpk AS (
  SELECT LEAST((lim - mean_pe) / NULLIF(3*sigma,0), (mean_pe + lim) / NULLIF(3*sigma,0)) AS value FROM stats
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(value)::NUMERIC, 2) AS value FROM cpk
)
SELECT n.value, ROUND((((n.value - p.value)/NULLIF(p.value, 0)::NUMERIC) * 100)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Delta %"
FROM now_val n, prev_val p

panels.description: Average process capability index (Cpk) across all machines with PE data. Higher is better. Target: >= 1.33.

targets.rawSql:
/* RESOLVED 2026-08-10 (migration 064): v_machine_spc_fleet is now a materialized view refreshed every 60s via a TimescaleDB background job, not recomputed per read. Previously QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT (~150ms); now sub-millisecond. */

panels.description: Weighted JE pass rate across all machines. Higher is better. Target: >= 98%.

panels.title: ◈ PE Limit Used

targets.rawSql:
/* QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT: simple aggregate over full-range ldi_data, but at current data volume (300K+ rows and growing) exceeds the 80ms real-time budget. Query Optimization pass (2026-08-06): documented rather than silently ignored; revisit if this becomes an operator-facing latency complaint. */
WITH pe_rows AS (
  SELECT
    GREATEST(
      ABS(pe_1), ABS(pe_2), ABS(pe_3),
      ABS(pe_4), ABS(pe_5), ABS(pe_6)
    ) AS max_error,
    pe_setting
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo = ANY(ARRAY[${mo:sqlstring}])
    AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
    AND pe_1 IS NOT NULL
    AND pe_setting > 0
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(100.0 * max_error / pe_setting)::NUMERIC, 1) AS value
FROM pe_rows

panels.description: Average MAX|PE| divided by the PE limit stored on each record. This normalized scale allows machines with different PE limits to be compared fairly.

panels.title: ◉ Fleet Availability (%)

targets.rawSql:
WITH now_val AS (
WITH machines AS (
  SELECT device_id AS eqp_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='ldi' AND enabled AND device_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
),
latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (eqp_id) eqp_id, state
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE "time" > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo = ANY(ARRAY[${mo:sqlstring}])
  ORDER BY eqp_id, "time" DESC
)
SELECT ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.state = true) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS value
FROM machines m LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.eqp_id = m.eqp_id
),
prev_val AS (
WITH machines AS (
  SELECT device_id AS eqp_id FROM public.devices WHERE device_type='ldi' AND enabled AND device_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
),
latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (eqp_id) eqp_id, state
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE "time" BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours' AND NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour' AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND mo = ANY(ARRAY[${mo:sqlstring}])
  ORDER BY eqp_id, "time" DESC
)
SELECT ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.state = true) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS value
FROM machines m LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.eqp_id = m.eqp_id
)
SELECT n.value, ROUND((((n.value - p.value)/NULLIF(p.value, 0)::NUMERIC) * 100)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Delta %"
FROM now_val n, prev_val p

panels.title: ◈ Production & Process Table

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: always the true latest row per machine, not bounded by the dashboard time range -- see v_ldi_machine_latest_full (migration 052) */
SELECT dev.device_id AS "Machine", v.mo AS "Job (MO)", v.fpn AS "Part (FPN)", v.layer_name AS "Layer",
       CASE WHEN v.log_id IS NULL THEN 'NO_DATA' ELSE (v.board_no::TEXT || '/' || v.total_board::TEXT) END AS "Progress",
       ROUND(v.temperature::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Temp (°C)",
       ROUND(v.humidity::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Humidity (%RH)",
       ROUND(v.scan_speed::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Scan Speed (mm/s)",
       ROUND(v.thickness::NUMERIC, 3) AS "Thickness (mm)",
       ROUND(v.resist_dosage::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Resist Dosage",
       CASE WHEN v.state THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE 'IDLE' END AS "State",
       CASE WHEN v.is_stale THEN 'STALE (>5min)' ELSE 'live' END AS "Freshness"
FROM public.devices dev
LEFT JOIN public.v_ldi_machine_latest_full v
  ON v.eqp_id = dev.device_id AND v.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND v.mo = ANY(ARRAY[${mo:sqlstring}])
WHERE dev.device_type = 'ldi' AND dev.enabled AND dev.device_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
ORDER BY dev.device_id

panels.description: Latest production context per machine (migration 052's v_ldi_machine_latest_full, System Audit Priority 2): job info + live physical parameters (temperature, humidity, scan_speed, thickness, resist_dosage, state). Always the true latest row regardless of the dashboard time range -- a silent machine still shows a row (Progress = NO_DATA) instead of disappearing.

panels.title: ◈ Calculated Time per Board

targets.rawSql:
/* QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT (re-verified 2026-08-18, Phase 1 panel repair): total_time has no
   avg_total_time equivalent at any CAGG tier (confirmed via \d public.ldi_data_1m/_15m/_1h --
   none of them carry a total_time-derived column), so no tiered repoint is possible without a
   migration (see Phase 1 repair report for the migration-proposal writeup this justifies, kept
   as a proposal only -- not created here). Re-measured live at current volume (public.ldi_data
   ~98,819 rows, not the stale "300K+ rows" this comment previously claimed): 52ms unbounded
   (full-table scan, all rows), 17ms at a 24h window -- both comfortably inside the 300ms hard
   query budget (docs/GRAFANA_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md). No migration warranted at current volume;
   revisit if row count or measured latency grows materially. */
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', "time", TIMESTAMPTZ '2000-01-01') AS "time", eqp_id AS metric,
       ROUND(AVG(total_time)::NUMERIC, 2) AS value
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE $__timeFilter("time") AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND mo = ANY(ARRAY[${mo:sqlstring}]) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND total_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.description: total_time is already the per-board cycle time (confirmed against the simulator, ~7-10s/board) -- previously divided by total_board again, producing a meaningless ~0.03s figure.

panels.title: ◈ Z-Score: temperature

targets.rawSql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, AVG(avg_temperature) AS mu, STDDEV_SAMP(avg_temperature) AS sigma
  FROM public.ldi_data_1m
  WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND mo = ANY(ARRAY[${mo:sqlstring}]) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND avg_temperature IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY eqp_id
)
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', d.bucket) AS "time", d.eqp_id AS metric, ROUND(AVG((d.avg_temperature-s.mu)/NULLIF(s.sigma, 0))::NUMERIC,2) AS "Z-Score"
FROM public.ldi_data_1m d JOIN stats s ON d.eqp_id=s.eqp_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(d.bucket) AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND d.mo = ANY(ARRAY[${mo:sqlstring}]) AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
  AND d.avg_temperature IS NOT NULL AND s.sigma > 0
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.description: Temperature Z-score per machine. Values > 2 or < -2 indicate statistically significant deviation.

panels.title: ◈ Recent Alarm Events (Last 50)

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: full dataset scope -- ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 50 already bounds it */
SELECT
  c.alarm_time AS "Time",
  c.eqp_id AS "Machine",
  c.alarm_id AS "Alarm Event ID",
  c.errorcode AS "Alarm Code",
  COALESCE(c.severity, 'UNMAPPED') AS "Severity",
  c.alarm_msg AS "Message",
  c.alarm_detail AS "Detail",
  COALESCE(cat.category, 'UNCLASSIFIED') AS "Subsystem",
  COALESCE(c.process, '-') AS "Process",
  CASE
    WHEN c.flag_pe_out_of_spec THEN 'PE/JE Out of Spec'
    WHEN c.flag_thermal_out_of_spec THEN 'Thermal Out of Spec'
    WHEN c.flag_humidity_out_of_spec THEN 'Humidity Out of Spec'
    WHEN c.flag_vac_out_of_spec THEN 'Vacuum Out of Spec'
    WHEN c.flag_scan_speed_out_of_spec THEN 'Motion Out of Spec'
    WHEN c.flag_exposure_out_of_spec THEN 'Exposure Out of Spec'
    WHEN c.match_type IS NULL THEN 'No Telemetry Linked'
    ELSE 'Within Spec'
  END AS "Quality Impact",
  c.mo AS "Job (MO)",
  CASE WHEN c.board_no IS NOT NULL THEN c.board_no::TEXT || '/' || c.total_board::TEXT ELSE '-' END AS "Board",
  c.related_log_id AS "Telemetry Event ID",
  COALESCE(c.match_type, 'none') AS "Match"
FROM public.v_ldi_alarm_context c
LEFT JOIN public.v_ldi_alarm_category cat ON cat.alarm_code = c.errorcode
WHERE c.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
ORDER BY c.alarm_time DESC LIMIT 50;

properties.value: Unique ID for this exact alarm occurrence (ldi_alarm_log.logid). Not the alarm type -- the same Alarm Code fires repeatedly; this ID identifies which specific firing this row is.
The alarm type/definition code from the vendor Alarm Master catalog (ldi_alarm_ms_code). Shared by every occurrence of this alarm type. Click to open the Alarm Dictionary.
The linked telemetry snapshot (ldi_data.log_id). See 'Match': exact = confirmed by direct log_id join; nearest = inferred by closest timestamp, not a confirmed link.

panels.description: Every alarm event, joined to the real Alarm Master (migration 061) for message/severity and to v_ldi_alarm_category for subsystem, plus the exact-or-nearest matched telemetry row (v_ldi_alarm_context, migration 063) for the machine's real process, job, and board at the moment of the alarm. "Quality Impact" reads the same out-of-spec flags the RCA Truth Test correlates against -- it answers whether this specific alarm coincided with a real measurable deviation, not just whether an alarm code fired. "Match" is 'exact' when related_log_id points at the exact telemetry row that caused a condition-driven alarm, 'nearest' for noise-pool codes falling back to the closest reading within 5 minutes.

panels.title: ◉ Top Correlated Alarms (24h)

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: view defines its own rolling 24h window.
   RESOLVED 2026-08-10 (migration 064): v_ldi_rca_recent_window is now a
   materialized view refreshed every 60s via a TimescaleDB background job,
   not recomputed per read. Previously QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT (~150ms); now
   sub-millisecond. */
SELECT alarm_category AS "Alarm Category",
       alarm_window_pct AS "Alarm-Window %",
       baseline_pct AS "Baseline %",
       lift AS "Lift",
       event_count AS "Event Count",
       confidence AS "Confidence"
FROM public.v_ldi_rca_recent_window;

panels.description: Alarms correlated with production deviations. Higher lift = stronger causal signal. Hide rows with sample < 30.

panels.title: ◉ Avg Cycle Time (Fleet)

targets.rawSql:
/* QUERY_BUDGET_EXEMPT (re-verified 2026-08-18, Phase 1 panel repair): same underlying
   total_time column as panel 12 (Calculated Time per Board) -- no avg_total_time equivalent
   at any CAGG tier (confirmed via \d public.ldi_data_1m/_15m/_1h), so no tiered repoint is
   possible without a migration (see Phase 1 repair report for the migration-proposal writeup
   this justifies, kept as a proposal only -- not created here). Re-measured live at current
   volume (public.ldi_data ~98,819 rows, not the stale "300K+ rows" this comment previously
   claimed): 29ms unbounded (full-table scan, all rows), 10ms at a 24h window -- both
   comfortably inside the 300ms hard query budget (docs/GRAFANA_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md). No
   migration warranted at current volume; revisit if row count or measured latency grows
   materially. */
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_time)::NUMERIC, 2) AS value
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND mo = ANY(ARRAY[${mo:sqlstring}]) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) AND total_time IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Average per-board cycle time (ldi_data.total_time) across the selected fleet/window. Thresholds: >12s warning, >18s critical (SM process boards run structurally longer -- ~7-25s -- than DF INNER/OUTER's ~7-10s, so this is a fleet-wide average, not a per-process spec limit).

panels.title: ◈ Board Traceability

targets.rawSql:
/* QUERY_BUDGET_OK -- linter-visibility note added 2026-08-18 (Phase 1 panel repair,
   independent re-evaluation per brief Objective 3): per-event lookup (ORDER BY time DESC
   LIMIT 200, descending-time index scan with effective chunk exclusion), not a downsample-
   eligible range scan -- board_no, log_id, the pe_1..pe_6 and je_1..je_4 quality fields, and
   thickness are all per-event fields with no equivalent in any ldi_data_1m, _15m, or _1h CAGG
   tier by design (event-level detail, not an aggregatable metric). Re-verified live: 24h
   window measures approximately 1.7ms (EXPLAIN ANALYZE, most chunks 'never executed'). This
   query never invokes the downsampling bucket function query-budget-linter.js checks for, and
   uses LIMIT 200 rather than LIMIT 1, so its own regex-based range-scan and exemption
   detection does not naturally classify this shape either way -- this comment documents the
   exemption reasoning explicitly rather than relying on that gap for silence. No query logic
   changed. */
SELECT "time" AS "Time", eqp_id AS "Machine", mo AS "Job (MO)", fpn AS "Part (FPN)",
       layer_name AS "Layer", (board_no::TEXT || '/' || total_board::TEXT) AS "Board",
       log_id AS "Telemetry Event ID",
       ROUND(total_time::NUMERIC, 2) AS "Cycle Time (s)",
       ROUND(GREATEST(ABS(pe_1),ABS(pe_2),ABS(pe_3),ABS(pe_4),ABS(pe_5),ABS(pe_6))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "Max |PE|",
       ROUND(GREATEST(ABS(je_1),ABS(je_2),ABS(je_3),ABS(je_4))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "Max |JE|",
       ROUND(thickness::NUMERIC, 3) AS "Thickness (mm)"
FROM public.ldi_data
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND mo = ANY(ARRAY[${mo:sqlstring}]) AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
ORDER BY "time" DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: One row per board processed (ldi_data has exactly one row per (eqp_id, mo, board_no) -- confirmed). Log ID is the per-board traceability key. The schema also has a board_id column, but it is always NULL (the simulator never populates it -- a known data gap) so it is omitted here rather than shown as a dead blank column.
